description: This file defines a React component 'SidebarRecommendations' that renders a list of recommended videos with thumbnails, titles, channel names, view counts, and publication dates. It handles filtering out the currently viewed video and formats view counts and dates for display.

methods.name: SidebarRecommendations
methods.description: React component that displays a list of recommended videos with thumbnails and metadata.

methods.name: formatViews
methods.description: Formats a number of views into a human-readable string (e.g., '1.2M views', '300K views', '999 views').

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats an ISO date string into a localized date string for display.
